subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: 15th December 2021 Departure Time: 10:00 AM We recommend arriving at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Airline Team
